inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is demanding outright rejection of the constitutional amendments that would extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. At his press conference he denounced the Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 as nothing more than an elite effort to hold power. This is the same tired progressive rhetoric the opposition always uses to undermine legitimate authority and national stability. What our country needs is respect for established leadership, personal responsibility, and the preservation of cultural continuity and social order, not these divisive attacks that erode traditional institutions and family values.
